levels.notes: House 55 / EG repeats the completed 1. OG apartment layout at the same campus position, including sixteen single apartments and four shared-apartment envelopes. The three blue-marked areas removed from 1. OG are retained on EG: two 9.30 x 4.50 m outer strips and the 2.70 x 2.90 m stair-side spur. The eastern common strip and its restored outer area form the cinema beside R. The western equivalents form the laundry beside L, as confirmed by the resident. Each 9.30 x 7.40 m enclosure has one hallway entrance near the stairs. The 7.83 square metre stair-side spur remains unassigned. Single apartments retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors and 3.10 m modules. Shared apartments A, W1, N3-N4 and G-H retain their 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelopes, including the perpendicular hall allowance. The 1.40 m hall runs and 2.70 m stair enclosure keep the exact first-floor geometry. The confirmed 8.10 m W return is retained. The resident confirmed an 8.10 m inner return instead of the annotated 5.00 m, preserving the 7.40 m top-floor core and all other final dimensions. Hallways are 1.40 m wide.
